candidates.definition_line: Wide-ranging engagement, opportunity sensed at a distance
candidates.face_teaser: You read money as movement, pulled toward the deal on the horizon more than the one already in hand. Opportunity registers at a distance, and you back the bet others hesitate on. Windfall energizes you. Routine quietly bores you. The skill is choosing which horizons are actually worth crossing.
candidates.family_clause: everything you treat as worth having and keeping

family_element.appetite: value, growth, and the things worth having
family_element.notAlone: not money alone, but everything you treat as worth acquiring and tending

__ore.note: TG corpus — the K2 generation source (kept per REA_03 §2.4)

rulingRealm.phrase: Risk/Opportunistic Vision — seeing potential before others recognize it
rulingRealm.desc: The part of a person that sees potential in everything and moves toward it broadly. Not the focused accumulation of 正财 but the ranging appetite that touches many things and activates what others walked past.

gifts: Instinctive sense for potential before it's visible — the read on what's worth engaging arrives before the evidence does
Natural abundance that activates things and people in its vicinity; others find opportunities and connections through proximity
Genuine openness to what's possible across an unusually wide field
shadows: What is touched broadly is never fully owned — the breadth that is the gift is also what prevents full possession
Activates without consolidating: builds real things that other people end up keeping
What is never fully possessed can be lost without the person fully registering what they had
__ore.hiddenDynamic: The interior truth that rarely gets named: everything feels equally interesting and equally possible, which is both the gift and the structural trap. The inability to fully invest in any one thing is not indecision — it is the nature of the ranging quality.

outputs.desc: Your sense for what's worth engaging arrives before the evidence does — you see potential before it's visible.
Things and people come alive in your vicinity; others find opportunities and connections simply through proximity.
You hold a genuine openness to what's possible across an unusually wide field of things.

frictions.desc: What you touch broadly is never fully owned — the breadth that's your gift also prevents full possession.
You activate without consolidating, building real things that other people end up keeping.
What was never fully possessed can be lost before you've registered what you actually had.

career.mechanism: 偏财 → ranging intelligence, opportunity activation across many domains
career.text: Thrives in sales, business development, entrepreneurship, and any role where moving across many domains and activating opportunity is the primary value. The ranging intelligence IS the product.

relationships.mechanism: 偏财 → broad warmth, elusive depth, diffuse investment
relationships.text: Charming and genuinely warm across many connections, but full depth with any single person is harder than breadth across many. Partners often feel the warmth is real but the full presence is somehow always partially elsewhere.

wealth.mechanism: 偏财 → multiple income streams, generation over accumulation
wealth.text: Natural sense for where money can be made, especially through opportunity and social connection. Usually better at generating wealth than keeping it. Multiple income streams natural and preferred.

health.mechanism: 偏财 → breadth depletes, rest deprioritized, paternal lineage
health.text: Involvement in so many things makes genuine rest genuinely rare. The body's signals for slowing down tend to be treated as opportunities for new engagement. Classically relates to the father and paternal lineage in health pattern transmission.

domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Wealth.helping.ahead: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through salary, a deal or a side venture or a move. You take more chances with money than you did ten years earlier, and most of them pay.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Wealth.helping.lived: Openings came your way in those years, a side deal, a lucky move or a contact with an offer. You made money in ways a salary never paid, and you grew bolder with it.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Wealth.heavy.lived: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what saved you was the steady income underneath.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Wealth.heavy.ahead: Chances multiply in these years and spread you thin, with more deals in view than you can follow. One reliable source keeps paying while the others rise and fall, and you come through with your savings intact.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.helping.ahead: Your family widens in these years, through a partner's relatives, new arrivals or a household that keeps its door open. You spend more on the people around you than ever before, and you mind it less than you expected.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.heavy.lived: Work and travel pulled you away from home in those years, and the people closest to you saw less of you than they wanted. You made it up in bursts of generosity, and your family forgave more than you expected.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Social.helping.ahead: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and people met through other people. You make more new friends in this decade than in the two before it.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Social.heavy.lived: Acquaintances crowded those years, and few of them stayed close. You knew people in many places and confided in almost none, and the one old friend who stayed kept you steady.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Social.heavy.ahead: New contacts arrive faster than you can keep them in these years, and old friends drift to the edge. A small group who knew you before the busy decade keeps your footing, and you return to them again and again.

helping.ahead: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a well-timed move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay.
helping.lived: Openings came your way in those years, a timely move or a chance offer or someone who knew someone. Money reached you by routes regular pay never took, and you grew bolder with it.

heavy.lived: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.
heavy.ahead: Chances multiply in these years and spread you thin, with more offers and requests than you can follow. One reliable source keeps paying while the others rise and fall, and you come through with your savings intact.

helping.ahead: Your family widens in these years, through new relatives, friends who become family or a household that keeps its door open. You spend more on the people around you than you used to, and you mind it less than you expected.
helping.lived: Your household opened outward in those years, through travel, new relatives or friends who became family. You gave generously to everyone at home, and the house was busier for it.

heavy.lived: Plans and people far from home pulled you away in those years, and your family saw less of you than they wanted. You made it up in bursts of generosity, and you came through because your family forgave more than you expected.
heavy.ahead: Distant plans crowd out home life in these years, and the people nearest to you feel the gap. What brings you back is a relative who asks plainly for your time, and you give it once you see the cost.

helping.ahead: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and the people they lead you to. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.
helping.lived: Your circle spread wide in those years, through travel, work and friends of friends. You met people easily everywhere you went, and several of them opened doors for you.

heavy.lived: Acquaintances crowded those years, and you knew people in many places without letting many of them close. One old friend who stayed kept you steady, and you confided in that friend more than in anyone new.
heavy.ahead: You meet more people in these years than you can keep up with, and old friends see less of you. A small group who knew you before this busy decade stays close, and you return to them again and again.
